You support a real estate owner-operator that leases space to a national CPG brand for a chain-wide retail replenishment network. Using the property-level asset register (AssetRegister sheet) and a detailed invoice log (Invoices sheet), classify each expenditure as CapEx vs OpEx based on the company's capitalization policy (CapPolicy sheet) and the asset category involved. Then build a property-level summary with CapEx by category, per-unit metrics, and reserve-planning exceptions.

Step 1 - Invoices Classification: On the Invoices sheet, add four columns starting at K: CapEx Category (K), CapEx/OpEx Classification (L), Capitalizable Amount ($) (M), and Operating Amount ($) (N). Classification logic: look up the Spend Type (column F) in CapPolicy (A column) to get Default Classification and Min Cap Threshold. If Default Classification is 'CapEx' and Amount >= Min Cap Threshold, classify as 'CapEx'; otherwise 'OpEx'. For CapEx Category: first check if GL Description (column E) contains any keyword from CapPolicy column D (rows where keyword is non-empty: 'compressor' maps to HVAC, 'membrane' maps to Roof, 'overlay' maps to Parking via column E of CapPolicy). If no keyword match, map from System/Area (column H): Building Shell or 'roof' in description -> Roof; Cooler/Freezer/Backroom -> HVAC; Dock -> Unit Upgrades; Front-of-House -> Unit Upgrades; otherwise -> Parking. Capitalizable Amount = Amount if CapEx, else 0. Operating Amount = Amount if OpEx, else 0.

Step 2 - Properties Rollups: On the Properties sheet, add columns H through M: CapEx Total ($) (H), OpEx Total ($) (I), CapEx per Unit ($/unit) (J), CapEx % of Value (K), CapEx Invoice Count (L), OpEx Invoice Count (M). Use SUMIFS and COUNTIFS on Invoices data matching Property ID.

Step 3 - AssetRegister RUL: On the AssetRegister sheet, add columns H through J: Useful Life (Years) (H) looked up from UsefulLives by CapEx Category, RUL (Years) (I) = Useful Life minus years elapsed from Last Major CapEx Date (or In-Service Date if blank) to the Analysis Date in Summary!B1, RUL Status (J) = 'Expired' if RUL <= 0, 'Warn' if RUL <= Warning Window from UsefulLives, else 'OK'.

Step 4 - Summary: The Summary sheet has parameters in rows 1-2 (Analysis Date in B1, CapEx % Threshold in B2 as decimal e.g. 0.03 for 3%), headers in row 3, and property data in rows 4-11. Input columns A-E (Property ID, Store Name, Market, Units, Property Value) are pre-filled. Add formulas for columns F through S: Roof CapEx ($) (F), HVAC CapEx ($) (G), Parking CapEx ($) (H), Elevators CapEx ($) (I), Unit Upgrades CapEx ($) (J) - each using SUMIFS on Invoices Capitalizable Amount matching Property ID and CapEx Category. Total CapEx ($) (K) = SUM of F:J. Total OpEx ($) (L) = SUMIFS on Invoices Operating Amount by Property ID. CapEx per Unit (M) = Total CapEx / Units. CapEx % of Value (N) = Total CapEx / Property Value. CapEx % Flag (O) = 'Over' if N > threshold in $B$2, else 'OK'. Nearest RUL (P) = MINIFS on AssetRegister RUL years by Property ID. RUL Flag (Q) = 'Expired' if Nearest RUL <= 0, 'Warn' if <= 2, else 'OK'. CapEx Invoice Count (R) and OpEx Invoice Count (S) using COUNTIFS on Invoices.

Prepare a monthly budget vs. actual summary for the department's operating expenses. The Budget sheet contains monthly budget amounts (Period, Budget columns). On the Summary sheet, for each month listed in column A, calculate: Budget (sum of budget for that month from Budget sheet), Actual (sum of actual spend for that month from Actuals sheet), Variance (Actual minus Budget), and Variance % (Variance divided by Budget, blank if Budget is zero). Add a Total row that sums Budget and Actual columns, calculates total Variance and Variance %. Add an Over-Budget Months row that counts how many months have Variance > 0. The Summary sheet should have columns Period, Budget, Actual, Variance, and Variance %. Place headers in row 1, monthly data in rows 2-4, Total in row 5, and Over-Budget Months count in row 6.

Compute monthly time-weighted returns (TWR) for each portfolio using daily subperiod returns. On the 'ARR_Movements' sheet, add columns K through N with headers in row 1 and formulas in rows 2-26: Expansion ARR (K) = Upsell ARR + Cross-sell ARR; Ending ARR (L) = Beginning ARR + Expansion ARR - Contraction ARR - Churn ARR; Customer NRR (M) = IF(Beginning ARR > 0, Ending ARR / Beginning ARR, blank); Expansion Flag (N) = 'Y' if Expansion ARR > 0, else 'N'. Expansion Rank (M) = 1 + COUNTIFS counting customers in the same quarter with higher Total Expansion ARR (rank 1 = highest). Cumulative Expansion ARR (N) = SUMIFS of Total Expansion for ranks <= current rank within the same quarter. Cumulative % of Total Expansion (O) = Cumulative Expansion / total expansion for the quarter (0 if no expansion). Pareto Bucket (P) = 'Top 80%' if Cumulative % <= 0.8, else 'Remaining'. On the 'Segment_Summary' sheet, add columns B through M with headers in row 1 and formulas in rows 2-5 for 4 segments (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, Strategic). Use COUNTIFS and SUMIFS against ARR_Movements filtered by Segment (col A) and the selected quarter (Executive_Output!B2). Columns: Customers (B) = count of customers; Customers w/ Expansion (C) = count where Expansion ARR > 0; Beginning ARR (D); Upsell ARR (E); Cross-sell ARR (F); Total Expansion ARR (G) = Upsell + Cross-sell; Contraction ARR (H); Churn ARR (I); Ending ARR (J) = Beginning + Expansion - Contraction - Churn; NRR (K) = IF(Beginning > 0, Ending / Beginning, blank); Expansion Mix % (L) = Upsell / Total Expansion (0 if no expansion); % of Total Expansion (M) = segment expansion / sum of all segments' expansion. On the 'Executive_Output' sheet, populate column B with formulas: B2 already contains the selected quarter '2025-Q4'. B4 = Total Beginning ARR (SUMIFS on ARR_Movements for the selected quarter). B5 = Total Expansion ARR (sum of Upsell + Cross-sell for the quarter). B6 = Total Contraction ARR. B7 = Total Churn ARR. B8 = Total Ending ARR = B4 + B5 - B6 - B7. B9 = Overall NRR = IF(B4 > 0, B8 / B4, blank). B11-B15 = Names of the Top 5 Expansion Accounts using INDEX/MATCH on Customer_Expansion Expansion Rank column (rank 1 through 5). B18 = Pareto: minimum Expansion Rank where Cumulative % >= 80% (using MINIFS). B19 = % of total expansion from the top 20% of expanding accounts: TopN = ROUNDUP(0.2 * count of accounts with expansion > 0, 0), then SUMIFS of expansion for ranks <= TopN divided by total expansion. B20 = Top Segment by Expansion ARR (INDEX/MATCH on max Total Expansion in Segment_Summary). B21 = NRR of the top segment (INDEX/MATCH on Segment_Summary).
